anomalies.description: A large, rapidly expanding fireball and smoke plume erupts from a ground location, consistent with a high-energy explosion (e.g., rocket launch failure or detonation). The event begins with initial ignition at ~24.5 s and grows in intensity and size through 31.5 s.
A rocket or missile in flight undergoes catastrophic structural failure and disintegrates in a large fireball and expanding debris cloud, consistent with an in-flight explosion.

A large, sudden explosion occurs with a bright orange fireball and rapidly expanding debris cloud; multiple streaks of incandescent fragments radiate outward, consistent with a high-energy detonation.; The explosion transitions into a sustained plume of smoke and residual burning material; the fireball dissipates but a dense, rising column of dark smoke persists, with scattered glowing particles still visible, indicating ongoing combustion from the initial blast.
